string.text: Show or hide the HUD minimap with a keybind. Single or Double toggles it; Hold shows it only while the key is down. No key bound by default. Suppresses Minimap Toggle (RavenAscendant); keep DOGMA below it in MO2, or disable that mod.
Single/Double toggle the minimap; Hold shows it while held. Optional modifier below can reduce conflicts.
Single or Double: toggle on press. Hold: show only while the key is held (starts hidden in Hold).
